statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The symptoms are non-sustained in nature
There is a need for extended rhythm correlation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The submitted clinical indication note supports the medical necessity of this service
